manifest.name: nvfp4-gptq-mlp-gdn-fp8-mid24-35-lmhead-q4k
manifest.description: #74 (nvfp4_blockfit everywhere, FP8 on the recurrent layers 24-35, lm_head fitted once: RP-KL 0.0896, decode 92.6, prefill 16.2k) with every MLP block encoded by nvfp4_gptq. #102 measured the same swap on the FP8-qkv attention-Q4_K map (#93): RP-KL 0.0743 to 0.0688 at identical decode, prefill and memory. Formats and kernels here are #74's, so speed and memory should not move; drift should fall by a similar amount, to about 0.084, while keeping #74's prefill, which the attention-Q4_K maps give up.
